crossRefs.note: Yahweh will command his loving kindness in the daytime. In the night his song shall be with me: a prayer to the God of…
But no one says, ‘Where is God my Maker, who gives songs in the night,
For though the fig tree doesn’t flourish, nor fruit be in the vines; the labor of the olive fails, the fields yield no…
yet I will rejoice in Yahweh. I will be joyful in the God of my salvation!
“Arise, go to Nineveh, that great city, and preach against it, for their wickedness has come up before me.”
But about midnight Paul and Silas were praying and singing hymns to God, and the prisoners were listening to them.
Stand in awe, and don’t sin. Search your own heart on your bed, and be still.
I said to myself, “Behold, I have obtained for myself great wisdom above all who were before me in Jerusalem. Yes, my…
Search me, God, and know my heart. Try me, and know my thoughts.
See if there is any wicked way in me, and lead me in the everlasting way.
I will tell God, ‘Do not condemn me. Show me why you contend with me.
Let us search and try our ways, and turn again to Yahweh.
But let a man examine himself, and so let him eat of the bread, and drink of the cup.

translations.web: I remember my song in the night. I consider in my own heart; my spirit diligently inquires:
translations.bsb: At night I remembered my song; in my heart I mused, and my spirit pondered:
translations.kjv: I call to remembrance my song in the night: I commune with mine own heart: and my spirit made diligent search.
translations.asv: I call to remembrance my song in the night: I commune with mine own heart; And my spirit maketh diligent search.
